collection.title: Citroen Berlingo Tailgate Rear Door 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen Berlingo 2018 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, BOSCH recommendation is 26" & 17". This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. PLEASE NOTE: These wiper blades are only suitable for models which have non-integrated washer jets.
